additional_info.subject: ID0481651-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/U14002952446] Main Breaker Not Closing CRM:03042000530
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0481651
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/U14002952446
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Y2/U14002952446
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following your request and after our check, we can confirm that the main breaker is tripped, as you can see in the logs.
To resolve this issue, please follow the steps below
My first as always is to check if the XD9.1 is inserted tightly. These are those loose connectors.
Second is by applying (or checking) 24V on the QA28 and then QA29, we should be able to get 230V until the input of both L+ and ON in the MA1, from the logic below:
If we apply 24V on the A1-A2 and the contact 11-14 doesn't close then we need to replace QA29, same process with QA28
Next thing is to check 24V on the Under voltage relay, the QA1 feedback should not be closing so you must not have 24V between .1 and .4.
The 24V to the UVR are supplied by QA26:
Next question, when you reach the site, what is the LED color of the ACT and TRIP in the QA1? (seen from the front)
If both LEDs are on then that means MA1 is faulty and needs replacement.
If everything above checks out properly and it still doesn't work (230V in MA1, QA26 sending 24V, 24V in KF5 - first photo and KF2, for QA29 and QA28 - second photo). Please measure on the output of the QA1 if any phase is not having the 230/380V:
If we don't have a phase or multiple phases then we need to replace the QA1 but MA1 should not be necessary or the UVR.
If QA26 is not sending the 24V for the UVR, then we need to check which of these lines is not getting 24V:
If all of them checks out fine and we still don't have 24V in the output (24) then we need to replace the QA26.
I don't think it's the feedback of the QA1 since we don't have the error called "Failure in Feedback line".
Usually when we have these kind of problems it's the MA1 but let's prove it.
My recommendation is to take a spare MA1, QA26, QA28/29 (they are the same) and UVR. Let me know if you think you should take a QA1, I can recommend it too.
Following our previous analysis, we identified that the issue is related to the FC16. At the moment, there are no active errors on the charger, and everything is functioning normally.
If the error is currently live on your side, we can arrange for a technician to visit the site and perform a check.
For now, we will keep the charger under monitoring. If the error appears again, we can proceed with a site visit and replace the FC16 if necessary.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

Hi,
I was on site yesterday and was able to replace the BT2.
Additionally, I noticed that the QA29 has an internal loose contact at the relay.
Therefore, this unit will need to be replaced during the next visit.
I still need to upload the work order.
Kind regards,
Johannes
